pieces.title: Minuet in B-flat major
pieces.tempoSource: Editorial: quarter = 100, moderate minuet practice tempo; source has no tempo.
pieces.levelNote: No published syllabus placement located. Level 2: short two-part notebook minuet, with grace notes and compact hand positions. Measured heuristic proposes 2; compared with the existing notebook dances and little preludes.
pieces.notes: Mutopia edition contributor: Steven McDougall. Source edition and licence in fetched RDF. Fresh online recheck 2026-10-15; Both MIDI comparisons are exact; MusicXML schema validation and medium/large playability gates pass. Anonymous notebook composition, traditionally attributed to Bach; BWV Anh. 118. Engraved from Bach-Gesellschaft volume 43 (1894), Public Domain dedication by Steven McDougall (Mutopia 1014). Two syntax-only catalog patches normalize the source's terminal rehearsal-mark fermata glyphs to directed note fermatas on the same final second-ending dotted halves (upright above the right hand, inverted below the left); the original markup marks are removed. Pitches, onsets, durations and MIDI remain unchanged.

pieces.notes: Mutopia edition contributor: Bas Wassink. Source edition and licence in fetched RDF. Fresh online recheck 2026-10-15; Both MIDI comparisons are exact; MusicXML schema validation and medium/large playability gates pass. Engraved from an unnamed late-19th-century edition (Mutopia 191, Public Domain). The source header prints Menuett although its Mutopia metadata calls it Rondo. The full source ends with D.C. al Fine, which the converter stores as text and the app cannot execute; this excerpt keeps the complete 16-bar C major theme ending on tonic, rather than ending playback in F major. No notes altered.
pieces.excerpt: Bars 1-16 of 32: the C major minuet theme through the Fine; the F major contrasting section and D.C. al Fine are omitted.
